name: recall-line
title: A reminder when a prompt refers to earlier work
command: eval/skill_eval.py run --set all --only IDS --ask plain --cond C,R

conditions.questions: 13 whose wording triggers the reminder ("do you remember", "last time", "didn't we")
conditions.source: the author's own session archive; only counts leave it

summary: ctx recall adds one line telling the agent to search first. Agents already searched every time, so the hook is not installed by default.

metrics.label: Searched the archive, with the reminder

bar: at least 60% searched with it, and more than without
baseline: the same agent without the reminder
meaning: The reminder changed nothing because agents already searched every time. The hook exists but is off by default. This test cannot show what happens deep in a long session, where the reminder might matter more.
